name: Lemon Pepper Steak with Mashed Potatoes & Green Beans

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil.
Wash, peel, and large dice potatoes; add to saucepan. Once boiling, cook until potatoes are tender, 10-12 minutes.

Peel and mince garlic. Grate 3 tsp of lemon zest. In a medium bowl, prepare marinade by mixing together ¼ of the garlic (save the rest for the green beans), lemon zest, lemon juice, oil, oregano, pepper, and salt.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 cloves garlic
1 ½ lemon
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp oregano
¾ tsp black pepper
⅜ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place steak in bowl and coat with marinade.
Wash green beans and trim ends.
Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Coat grill or bottom of skillet with oil. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
instructions.secondary_message: about 1 ½ tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: Heat a sauté pan over medium heat and add coconut oil. Add remaining garlic and crushed red pepper. Cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
instructions.secondary_message:
about 1 ½ tbsp virgin coconut oil
⅜ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add green beans to the sauté pan and, stirring occasionally, cook until tender crisp, 5-7 minutes.
Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Drain potatoes and return back to saucepan. Add parsley, chicken broth, oil, salt, and pepper. Mash until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
354 ml (1 ½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth
3 tbsp virgin coconut oil
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Remove beans from heat. Season with salt and pepper; toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, arrange steak, mashed potatoes and green beans on a plate. Enjoy!
